Worker report # TAT-3077 Report ## Summary Fixed Recent activity headers so the full row is tappable on the Perps tab and Perp market detail page. The existing arrow controls now span the row while preserving their route handlers and test IDs. ## Root cause `ui/components/app/perps/perps-recent-activity/perps-recent-activity.tsx:145` and `ui/components/app/perps/perps-market-recent-activity/perps-market-recent-activity.tsx:111` wrapped only the arrow icon in `ButtonBase`. The title area was rendered by a non-clickable layout `Box`, unlike `ui/components/app/perps/perps-explore-markets/perps-explore-markets.tsx:50`, where the whole row is the button. ## Changes - `ui/components/app/perps/perps-recent-activity/perps-recent-activity.tsx` — made the Perps tab Recent activity header a full-width row button. - `ui/components/app/perps/perps-market-recent-activity/perps-market-recent-activity.tsx` — made the market detail Recent activity header a full-width row button when activity exists. - `ui/components/app/perps/perps-recent-activity/perps-recent-activity.test.tsx` — added coverage for clicking the header text. - `ui/components/app/perps/perps-market-recent-activity/perps-market-recent-activity.test.tsx` — added coverage for clicking the header text. ## Test plan Automated: - `yarn lint:changed && yarn verify-locales --quiet && yarn circular-deps:check` -
